question: In year 2023, the Government of India launched which of the following schemes to bring Indian-origin researchers to higher educational institutions in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VAIBHAV**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **VAIBHAV** is the scheme launched by the Government of India in **2023 **to bring** Indian-origin researchers to higher educational institutions** in the country.
 
• VAIBHAV stands for **Vaishwik Bharatiya Vaigyanik (VAIBHAV) Summit**.
 
• The initiative aims to create a platform for global Indian researchers and academicians to collaborate with domestic institutions.
 
• The scheme is part of India's effort to harness the talent and expertise of its diaspora to boost scientific and technological research in the country.
 
• VAIBHAV focuses on diverse fields including science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and medicine, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The VAIBHAV Summit is an initiative of the Government of India to bring together Indian-origin researchers from across the globe to share their knowledge and expertise.
 
• The summit aims to foster collaboration and strengthen the research ecosystem in India.
 
• It is aligned with India's vision of becoming a global leader in science and technology.
 
• The summit includes various sessions, workshops, and discussions on emerging areas of research and innovation.
 
• The initiative is expected to significantly contribute to India's development goals by leveraging the intellectual capital of the Indian diaspora.
